name: Differential Equations: Odelo
subtitle: Differential Equations Course
shortDescription: Adaptive differential equations course: practice that learns from your mistakes, interactive labs and full worked solutions. Free to use.
longDescription:
Differential Equations: Odelo is an adaptive differential equations course for second-year undergraduates. Study first-order differential equations (separable, linear, exact), modelling, existence and uniqueness, numerical methods, second-order linear differential equations, Laplace transforms, systems with phase portraits, and series solutions.

### What makes it different
- A personalised path that follows your mistakes, or the traditional course order. Switch any time.
- Practice that spots the slip behind a wrong answer, schedules spaced review and picks your next question.
- 282 original practice questions with full worked solutions, timed unit tests and three mock finals.
- Six hero simulations: Field Weaver (a living slope field with equilibria), Portrait Atlas (nine phase-portrait classes on the trace-determinant plane), Step Lab (Euler, Heun and RK4 error orders and stability regions), Oscillator Helix (a 3D driven oscillator with resonance curve), Pole Stage (Laplace poles and a sliding convolution) and Bifurcation Strip. Every number is checked by a second method on screen and each lab has a Sources button that opens its textbook and course references in the app.
- Five more labs: slope fields, spring-mass-damper, phase portraits and eigenvalues, Euler versus Runge-Kutta, predator-prey.
- Tap any concept for a short explanation from school level up to graduate level, plus before-this-course and after-this-course pages.
- Every source is cited and linked (MIT OpenCourseWare, OpenStax, Khan Academy, Coursera, edX, textbooks, popular videos); nothing is copied.
- Text size buttons (A- and A+) on every screen, and your progress stays on your device. No account needed.

Free with optional ads at natural breaks (never during timed tests). Differential Equations Ad-Free is an optional monthly auto-renewing subscription with a 7-day free trial that removes ads. The price is shown by the App Store before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple ID, the subscription renews each month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends, and you can manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings. Explanations and solutions are never locked.

Not affiliated with, or endorsed by, any university, course provider or publisher named in the app.
